periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation with the primary axis tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical ovoid geometry where the height of the patch exceeds its width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct tapering at the base of the patch, narrowing as it approaches the rostrum.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a relatively flat transition across the spinal column.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible upper torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation between the ear structures at the superior-lateral cranial margins.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the superior boundary of both ears.
